preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 400,000.
The number of operations k in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.
The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 400,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of remaining vertices after k operations.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= t <= 10**4","description":"The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= n <= 4 * 10**5","description":"The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 400,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= k <= 2 * 10**5","description":"The number of operations k in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000."},{"id":"P4","expression":"sum(n) <= 4 * 10**5","description":"The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 400,000."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(remaining_vertices)","description":"The output must be the number of remaining vertices after k operations."}],"invariants":[]}
